title: Indian Navy SSC Officers Various Post June 2027 Batch Online Form 2026 Date Extended
postName: Short Service Commission Officers – June 2027 Course (Various Entries)

shortDescription: Indian Navy SSC Officers June 2027 Batch Online Form – last date extended to 03 August 2026. Apply at joinindiannavy.gov.in.
content:
Indian Navy has invited online applications for Short Service Commission Officers – June 2027 course (various entries).

Online applications opened from 25 June 2026. The last date has been extended up to 03 August 2026 as per official notice. Training will commence at the Indian Naval Academy (INA), Ezhimala, Kerala.

Selection is through shortlisting, SSB interview and medical examination. Apply only on joinindiannavy.gov.in and read branch-wise eligibility carefully.
